parent_experiment.relationship: V9 is the next qualification treatment after immutable V8; task order, model, prompt, controller, PatchManager, hidden-data boundary, and one-attempt policy are inherited unchanged.

qualification_boundary: Results cannot be promoted into an unseen benchmark capability score.
first_ten_order_policy: exact prefix of the immutable source full ordering; no resampling or reordering
treatment_changes_from_v8: metadata discovery has a separate 60-second deadline
generation starts a fresh 240-second absolute deadline
outer profile request deadline is 360 seconds, above the 60+240 provider envelope with cleanup margin
external Git source materialization is bounded at 90 seconds before the pinned cache fallback
official evaluator Git commands are bounded at 90 seconds, Docker inspect/pull at 300 seconds, and the evaluator wrapper at a 600-second watchdog
the pinned official evaluator has no finite container/test timeout; the 600-second wrapper is hang safety only, not semantic test authority
an existing external evaluator checkout at the pinned commit is reused without a network fetch
the pinned evaluator HEAD is read locally before any Git subprocess is considered
Ollama chat uses bounded NDJSON streaming and discards private thinking from the protocol response
prompt, completion, and total token counts are retained in the command response telemetry
official evaluator timeout, process failure, elapsed seconds, stderr tail, and timeout semantics are retained in verifier evidence

generation telemetry retains bounded numeric wire, retained-content, discarded-thinking counts, first-chunk latency, last-progress time, completion time, timeout phase, and progress-before-timeout; thinking text is never persisted

evaluation.correctness_authority: official SWE-rebench independent verifier via OfficialSWERebenchVerifier
evaluation.model_workspace: base commit only; no test_patch; no gold patch
evaluation.verifier_workspace: base commit + hidden test_patch; gold never applied as model input
evaluation.hidden_data_boundary: intrinsic model task isolation; private bundle consulted only after candidate

harness.common_architectural_baseline_semantics: V6 frozen harness-content identity carried as a common baseline; it is not the immediate experiment parent

provenance.v8_external_evidence: V8 is immutable historical evidence; V9 is the next direct qualification treatment.
provenance.qualification_observation: V9 has no qualification result yet; no live qualification or unseen pilot is authorized by this frozen contract until deterministic and critical-diff audits pass.

timeout_semantics.official_evaluator_timeout_semantics: pinned evaluator has no container/test timeout; outer watchdog is hang safety only
